**Node.js 22.0.0 GitHub release page**

- **Official release:** [Release 2024-04-24, Version 22.0.0 (Current)](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0) — tagged by RafaelGSS and marco-ippolito on 24 Apr 2024. Highlights: `require()` of ESM graphs, WebSocket client enabled by default, V8 update, and more. Node.js 22 was Current at release and was planned to enter LTS in October. [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)

**Related sources (up to 8)**

1. [github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0) — primary GitHub release notes and assets. [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)
2. [nodejs.org blog source: `v22.0.0.md`](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md) — release post (author Rafael Gonzaga, date 2024-04-24) plus download links and SHASUMs. [[2]](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md)
3. Notable changes in that post: drop import assertions; AbortSignal creation perf; watch mode stable; V8 12.4.254.14; WebSocket on by default; higher stream `highWaterMark`; Maglev on supported archs. [[2]](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md)
4. [CHANGELOG_V22.md](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md) — full v22 changelog in the node repo. [[3]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md)
5. [doc/changelogs directory](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tree/master/doc/changelogs) — changelog index including `CHANGELOG_V22.md`. [[4]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tree/master/doc/changelogs)
6. [nodejs/node tags](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tags) — tag list (later 22.x LTS tags such as v22.23.x also appear). [[5]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tags)
7. [nodejs/node releases](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases) — all Node.js GitHub releases. [[6]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases?page=2)
8. Docs and binaries from the release notes: [docs for v22.0.0](https://nodejs.org/docs/v22.0.0/api/) and [dist files](https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.0.0/). [[2]](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md)
